config_storage.description: Storage backend for the global configuration (e.g., File, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis). Specify type and options.

type.description: Storage backend type: File, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Neo4j, etc.

options.description: Backend-specific options (e.g., connection details, paths, credentials)

portal_url.description: Public URL of the LemonLDAP-NG portal (used for redirects, cookies, and links)

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warn, error, crit, alert, emerg

log_priority.description: Priority threshold for logging (only messages at or above this level are logged)

log_backend.description: Logging destination: syslog, file, stderr, or none

session_storage.description: Session data storage backend (File, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Memcached, etc.)

type.description: Session storage type: File, Redis, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Memcached, etc.

apps_storage.description: Storage backend for application-specific configurations (handlers, virtual hosts)

type.description: Storage type: File, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, etc.

secret_key.description: Secret key (≥32 chars) used to sign cookies and tokens. Must be kept secret. Auto-generated on first run.

cookie_domain.description: Domain for authentication cookies (e.g., .example.com). If empty, defaults to portal hostname.

cookie_secure.description: Require HTTPS for cookies (set to false only for testing or internal HTTP deployments)

maintenance.description: Enable maintenance mode: temporarily disable login and session renewal

debug.description: Enable debug mode: verbose logging, expose internal info to users

enable_portal.description: Enable the portal interface (login, profile, password change). Set to false for API-only deployments (e.g., embedded authentication)

custom_js.description: Path to custom JavaScript (relative to /static/ or absolute URL)

custom_css.description: Path to custom CSS (relative to /static/ or absolute URL)

oidc_enabled.description: Enable OpenID Connect provider features (discovery, token endpoint, userinfo)

saml_enabled.description: Enable SAML 2.0 identity and service provider support

oauth2_enabled.description: Enable OAuth2 authorization server features (token endpoint, introspection)

webfinger_enabled.description: Enable WebFinger support for decentralized identity resolution (.well-known/webfinger)

handlers.description: List of LemonLDAP-NG handlers (e.g., for reverse proxy integration, API gateways)

name.description: Handler name (matches the INI section header)

config.description: Handler-specific configuration key-value pairs (e.g., location, auth, rules)
